title: O(1) LRU cache
prompt: Implement a class LRUCache with __init__(self, capacity), get(self, key) and put(self, key, value). get returns the stored value or -1 when the key is absent. Both get and put must run in O(1) average time and both count as a use of the key. When put is called on a full cache, the least recently used key is evicted. capacity is a positive integer; raise ValueError otherwise.
